about: Graph practice set (12b). Invented notes in evals/brain/graph-practice/, indexed with a copy of the vault's wiki/ and raw/ in a temp folder, never in Jay's wiki. g01-g10: the words match one note and the answer is one link, source or project edge away. g11 and g12 are traps: in g11 the matched note links to the wrong note, in g12 the answer is a clear winner that a hub links away from; the graph must not make them worse. Questions written so a link leads to the answer show the graph can help, not how often it will in real notes.
